sources.title: GitHub - LostRuins/koboldcpp: Run GGUF models easily with a KoboldAI UI ...
sources.snippet: KoboldCpp is an easy-to-use AI text-generation software for GGML and GGUF models, inspired by the original KoboldAI. It's a single self-contained distributable that builds off llama.cpp and adds many additional powerful features. Download Releases Here.
